judgments.yea_description: Voted for House Bill 2013, which takes civil service and grievance rights away from new hires in five state agencies. They are the Bureau of Senior Services and the Departments of Administration, Environmental Protection, Revenue and Veterans' Assistance. From July 1, 2025, new hires there are at-will, with no civil service protection and no access to the state grievance process, unless an agency head keeps a job covered to meet federal law or funding rules. Current workers keep those rights only while they stay in their current job. The Senate passed it 24-10 and it became law.
